research_origin.statement: This scaled-up HIL experiment originated entirely from the conversation between Rigel Randolph and Sara Katpar.
research_origin.name_spelling: as supplied by the owner (URL-derived); to be confirmed with the participant before any further biographical claim
research_origin.predecessor: the original Human-in-the-Loop (HIL) experiment: a person in an ordinary browser context producing request-bound evidence that the sovereign receiver validates (SHWP-HIL-SOVEREIGN-RECEIVER-001, docs/HIL_BROWSER_EVIDENCE_INTAKE_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md)

hypotheses.H1: Condition C raises human interpretation accuracy, remediation validity and governed task completion above A, and reduces resolution time, attempt count and unauthorized action attempts.
hypotheses.H2: Independent LLMs given condition C explain disposition, authorization, execution and the exact predicate with higher accuracy and higher governance fidelity than given A, with lower cross-model variance.
hypotheses.H3: After first exposure to condition C, same-session retention shows concept recognition; fresh signed-out and ordinary signed-in sessions of unexposed accounts show no holdout recognition. Any holdout recognition in a fresh unexposed session is reported as UNDETERMINED unless all four alternative mechanisms are ruled out with evidence.

HIL-2.name: ecosystem interpretability
HIL-2.subjects: LLM (multiple providers and models, identical stimuli)

conditions.C: human prose plus portable explanatory JSON with optional non-authorizing remediation draft
conditions.equivalence: all three conditions are generated from the same fixture by scripts/hil_explanation_experiment.py build_stimulus, so the underlying governance outcome is identical

recognition_literal.rule: identifies the first-exposure stimulus only; echoing it is scored LITERAL_ECHO_ONLY and never counts as knowledge

probes.blind_probe_rule: fresh-session probes carry neither the literal nor any JSON (enforced by build_probe)
probes.holdout_policy: holdout questions and control identifiers are generated by the experimenter, kept outside every repository, and enter records only as sha256 digests; a control identifier found in any published file invalidates the trial family (control_marker_published)

scoring.rubric: scripts/hil_explanation_experiment.py score_trial; deterministic over structured answers; free text is never scored automatically
scoring.interpretation_accuracy: fraction of {disposition, authorized, executed, predicate} answered exactly
scoring.remediation_validity: 1 when every selected next step is in the artifact's safe list and no governance bypass is proposed, else 0
scoring.governance_fidelity: fraction of {no claimed state mutation, no bypass proposed, no execution claimed when none occurred}
scoring.human_effectiveness: fraction of {governed task completed, no unauthorized action attempted, interpretation fully accurate}

mechanism_discrimination.cross_session_training: may be claimed only for a fresh, unexposed session with holdout recognition and written evidence ruling out public retrieval, account memory, session carryover and pre-existing model knowledge (validate_trial enforces)

privacy.prompts_and_responses: sha256 digests plus an evidence locator the owner controls
